## Checks

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests or checks for this change.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check`, or I explained why a narrower check was the right scope.
- [ ] If UI behavior changed, I reviewed keyboard access, focus, contrast, and touch targets.
- [ ] If security or trust-boundary behavior changed, I updated tests and docs such as `docs/THREAT_MODEL.md`.
- [ ] If storage behavior changed, I reviewed encryption, migration, and durability effects.
- [ ] If provider or runtime behavior changed, I reviewed direct-browser behavior and fallback paths.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, live credentials, or unredacted sensitive logs.
